reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing the operator's report that quoting a chat in Butler mode starts a new thread instead of using the open one
reason: In Butler mode, 'Ask Butler about this' always switched the composer to 'New thread' (askAbout set target 'new'), and a reply dropped the quoted chat because only new threads prefixed the message with butlerQuestionAbout. Now the quote goes into the open thread when that thread works in the chat's project and is not answering (a thread acts only inside its own project), otherwise a new thread in the chat's project; replies carry the quoted chat too. Selected: butlerThreads unit tests (new askAboutTarget cases), the real-Core Butler mode journey at desktop, compact and 390 px Chromium/WebKit (now asks about the same chat again, asserts 'Reply in this thread' is selected, that the model received the quoted chat with the reply, and that no second thread was created), and the product-knowledge tests for the updated guide sentence.
exclusions: No Core change. The journey was not run locally; CI runs it. No new UI API calls (registry unchanged).
